g.text: Database work is outside the PLC scan.
Ring overflow remains explicit as loss documents.
Relational adapters commit internal canonical rows,
descriptive public read-model rows, and the absolute
ring cursor in one transaction. Influx uses durable
Every backend initializes the same schema generation 1.
The recorded catalog fingerprint covers native columns,
keys, checks, foreign keys, and indexes. Changed or
incomplete pre-release state fails without repair.
SQL Server splits canonical/event/domain groups at 100
projected documents and logged values at 53 rows so every
statement stays below the driver/product parameter boundary;
all chunks and every loss/unresolved row remain in the same
Initial remote open, initialization, and reconnect remain in
the supervised host worker and cannot block PLC startup.
Only explicitly classified remote reachability failures
retry during open. Schema compatibility and deterministic
storage failures fault immediately without reconnecting.
